title: Zesty Romantic Algerian Pappardelle Pasta
description: A flavorful and romantic Algerian dish featuring pappardelle pasta, confit tomato, and a blend of spices, cooked to perfection in a kadhai, this recipe is buddhist-temple-friendly as it does not contain any animal products.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pappardelle pasta according to the package instructions until it is al dente.
In a kadhai, heat the olive oil over medium heat and add the minced garlic, cooking until fragrant.
Add the algerian spice mix to the kadhai and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the fresh tomatoes to the kadhai, stirring to combine with the garlic and spice mix, and cook until they start to break down and form a confit.
Add the cooked pappardelle pasta to the kadhai, tossing to combine with the confit tomato mixture.
Season the pasta with salt, black pepper, and lemon juice, and stir to combine.
Transfer the pasta to a serving dish and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the Zesty Romantic Algerian Pappardelle Pasta hot, enjoying the flavors and textures of this romantic dish.
